samples.summary: DOCX import writes an unvalidated `pageSetup` straight into the CRDT, bypassing the new `assertUsablePageSetup` invariant
samples.evidence: The diff states the invariant on `writePageSetup` (`packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:2062`) because a closed/NaN content box "is written into the CRDT for every collaborator". But `writePageSetup` is not the only page-setup writer. `DocxImporter.import()` produces `{ blocks, pageSetup }` (`packages/docs/src/import/docx-importer.ts:158`) where `parsePageSetup` (`packages/docs/src/import/docx-parser.ts:288-319`) computes `width = Math.round(twipsToPx(parseInt(w,10)))` with no finiteness or positivity check (a non-numeric `w:w` yields NaN) and copies `w:pgMar` top/bottom/left/right verbatim — negative margins and margins summing past the page are all accepted. That document is then committed by `store.setDocument(pending)` at `packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-view.tsx:356`, which never reaches `assertUsablePageSetup`. The result is exactly the state the new guard exists to prevent: a page box `paginateLayout`, the ruler and the PDF exporter cannot consume, persisted for every collaborator. Fix belongs on the import/`setDocument` path (or in `resolvePageSetup`), not on the new guard.

samples.summary: The new markdown URL gate silently drops legitimate relative image sources and relative/anchor hrefs produced elsewhere in the app, in every consumer of `serializeMarkdown`
samples.evidence: `isSafeUrl` only accepts absolute http/https/mailto/tel (`packages/core/src/url/index.ts:24`), so `isSafeImageSrc` / `isEmittableUrl` now reject anything relative. Out-of-diff producers emit exactly that: `resolveImageUrl()` (`packages/frontend/src/app/docs/export-utils.ts:12-18`) returns a bare `/images/<id>` whenever `VITE_BACKEND_API_URL` is unset (same-origin deployment) and that value is stored as the image `src` by `docsImageUploader` → `insertImageFromFile` (`image-insert.ts:61-68`); HTML paste stores raw `<a href>` attributes verbatim, including `#anchor` and `/relative` targets (`packages/docs/src/view/clipboard.ts:597-599`, `:699-701`). Those images now serialize as the `[image]` placeholder and those links lose their destination in every Markdown output — the new frontend Export menu, the CLI's `docs content --format md` (`packages/cli/src/docs/content.ts:129`) and, because it shares the docs serializer, `slides content --format md` (`packages/cli/src/slides/content.ts:184`). Silent lossy behaviour change on content the gate was not aimed at.

samples.summary: Backend jest has no module mapping for `@wafflebase/core/url`, which the docs node entry now transitively imports
samples.evidence: `packages/backend/package.json:117` maps `@wafflebase/docs` to `../../docs/src/node.ts`, and that entry re-exports `serializeMarkdown` (`packages/docs/src/node.ts:165`), which after this change imports `@wafflebase/core/url` (`packages/docs/src/serialize/markdown.ts:12`). The jest config maps `@wafflebase/core/tokens` to core *source* (`package.json:119`) but has no `/url` entry, so backend specs that import `@wafflebase/docs` (e.g. `packages/backend/src/yorkie/docs-tree.spec.ts:5`) now resolve `@wafflebase/core/url` through `packages/core/dist`, which is gitignored and is not built by the backend coverage job (`.github/workflows/ci.yml:328-330` runs jest straight after `pnpm install`). Backend `tsc` is fine (its `paths` map `@wafflebase/core/*` to core src). Low confidence because `@wafflebase/core/geometry` already reaches the slides node entry unmapped, suggesting dist is normally present.

verdict.reason: Verified every element of the claim. `assertUsablePageSetup` (packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:962-993) is called only from `writePageSetup` (editor.ts:2058-2070), and its own comment (editor.ts:949) plus the design doc (docs/design/docs/docs-pagination.md:350) state the invariant protects what is "written into the CRDT for every collaborator" with "no second way to write". That claim is false: `parsePageSetup` (packages/docs/src/import/docx-parser.ts:288-320) computes `width = Math.round(twipsToPx(parseInt(w,10)))` at line 300 with a truthiness-only guard, so a non-numeric `w:w` yields NaN, and margins (lines 307-314) are copied verbatim, admitting negatives and sums that close the content box. That PageSetup flows out of `DocxImporter.import()` (packages/docs/src/import/docx-importer.ts:158) and is persisted by two reachable call sites that never touch the guard: packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-view.tsx:356 (`store.setDocument(pending)`) and packages/frontend/src/app/documents/apply-imported-content.ts:224 (`new YorkieDocStore(doc).setDocument(content.document)`), the latter driven by the upload queue's DOCX branch at packages/frontend/src/app/documents/upload-queue.ts:373-379. Nothing sanitizes en route: `YorkieDocStore.setDocument` writes pageSetup verbatim (yorkie-doc-store.ts:2872-2878, 2898-2903), `readPageSetup` only `Number()`-coerces (yorkie-doc-store.ts:530-543, so NaN survives), and `resolvePageSetup` (packages/docs/src/model/types.ts:751-758) is a shallow copy with default-only fallback. This is precisely the blast-radius lane — a newly stated guard with a reachable alternate entry point to the same protected write — so it is blocking, not out of scope.

finding.summary: The new markdown URL gate silently drops legitimate relative image sources and relative/anchor hrefs produced elsewhere in the app, in every consumer of `serializeMarkdown`
finding.evidence: `isSafeUrl` only accepts absolute http/https/mailto/tel (`packages/core/src/url/index.ts:24`), so `isSafeImageSrc` / `isEmittableUrl` now reject anything relative. Out-of-diff producers emit exactly that: `resolveImageUrl()` (`packages/frontend/src/app/docs/export-utils.ts:12-18`) returns a bare `/images/<id>` whenever `VITE_BACKEND_API_URL` is unset (same-origin deployment) and that value is stored as the image `src` by `docsImageUploader` → `insertImageFromFile` (`image-insert.ts:61-68`); HTML paste stores raw `<a href>` attributes verbatim, including `#anchor` and `/relative` targets (`packages/docs/src/view/clipboard.ts:597-599`, `:699-701`). Those images now serialize as the `[image]` placeholder and those links lose their destination in every Markdown output — the new frontend Export menu, the CLI's `docs content --format md` (`packages/cli/src/docs/content.ts:129`) and, because it shares the docs serializer, `slides content --format md` (`packages/cli/src/slides/content.ts:184`). Silent lossy behaviour change on content the gate was not aimed at.

verdict.reason: Verified independently. isSafeUrl (packages/core/src/url/index.ts:24-31) parses with `new URL()` and thus rejects all relative URLs (its own comment at :21-22 states this). markdown.ts:269-271 (isEmittableUrl) and :284-290 (isSafeImageSrc) both delegate to it, so relative hrefs lose their destination (:224-226) and relative image srcs degrade to the `[image]` placeholder (:305-307). Out-of-diff producers emit exactly those values: the backend returns a relative `/images/<key>` (packages/backend/src/image/image.service.ts:128) and resolveImageUrl returns it unchanged when VITE_BACKEND_API_URL is unset (packages/frontend/src/app/docs/export-utils.ts:5,16), after which it is stored verbatim as the image src via docsImageUploader -> docxImageUploader (docx-actions.ts:15) -> uploadImageFile (image-insert.ts:11-14) -> insertImageFromFile (image-insert.ts:61-68). HTML paste stores raw `href` attributes including `#anchor`/`/relative` (clipboard.ts:597-599, :699-701). The changed serializer is shared by out-of-diff consumers that were not adapted: CLI `docs content --format md` (packages/cli/src/docs/content.ts:129) and `slides content --format md` (packages/cli/src/slides/content.ts:184). MarkdownOptions (markdown.ts:25-28) offers no base-URL/resolution escape hatch, and no caller normalises src/href to absolute first, so there is no guard making this unreachable. This is a behaviour change to an exported symbol silently dropping content at other call sites — in-lane and major; not refutable on not-present, already-guarded, or out-of-scope grounds.
